phaseGateDisposition.F3: BLOCKED_FOR_PRODUCTION: the revision 57 local cycle-control delta adds no external provider claim. Existing deployed Robinhood, Programmable, provider, custody, finality, gas, publication, and release spikes remain incomplete and unwaived.
phaseGateDisposition.F4: BUILD_ONLY: revision 57 architecture 5 may freeze the local manual cycle-control contract while retaining every production blocker from the historical Robinhood binding. The freeze does not authorize signing, broadcast, deployment, asset movement, gas spend, or publication.

revision56DeltaAssessment.scope: Immutable PegCycleVault custody plus the retained P1-001 provider binding, zero-LP-fee fee contract, eight swap quadrants, and permanent launch-position custody
revision56DeltaAssessment.reason: PegCycleVault removes Operations custody locally, but immutable custody, authorizer, route-executor, bridge, policy-wallet, and fee semantics remain irreversible money-path controls. Production bindings stay unresolved.

revision57CycleControlDeltaAssessment.scope: Manual pack selection and plan freeze, one active cycle, same-cycle reconciliation-first recovery, failure-bound fresh successor cycles, and immutable per-cycle return escrows
revision57CycleControlDeltaAssessment.reason: Cycle-specific escrow isolation removes modeled successor contamination and reconciliation blocks blind retry, but each separately authorized cycle remains an irreversible money path and repeated cycles do not create a cumulative loss cap.

rulesApplied: No certified module is present, so no certified parameter envelope is claimed, extended, or used to lower risk.
Missing provider, custody, finality, gas, size, publication, owner or claim-destination policy, or authorization facts block execution and production interface freeze; they never lower a lane.
Any immutable issuance, hook, custody, liability, payout, transaction-construction, external-mutation, signing, broadcast, spending, distribution-compilation, or live-action work remains R4.
Any evidence, provider binding, authentication, proof, publication, finality, phase, or release decision that permits or blocks R4 work remains at least R3.

Every specification, architecture, feasibility, gate-run, interface-freeze, or receipt artifact consumed by a gate that permits or blocks R4 work has a minimum R3 lane even when the artifact itself is executable only as a local model or checker.

gateArtifactRiskFloor.reason: These artifacts can change whether immutable R4 implementation or live work is admitted, so read-only or documentary form does not reduce their control-plane impact.
paths: scenario-model, survivability-bounds, integration-spikes, interface-freeze, risk-lane, architecture-gate, and feasibility-gate receipts
gateArtifactRiskFloor.blockedArtifactRule: A planned path that does not yet exist remains R3 by role and cannot be treated as evidence. No absent architecture/interfaces.json, feasibility/interface-freeze.json, gate run, or receipt is created or inferred by this assessment.

scope: local operator plan and journal state
Relay quote request and executable payload construction
Collector generate, open, buyback, and submitTransaction mutations
launch, deployment, admission, pool initialization, canary, payout funding, and holder-payment live actions
lanes.reason: These modules define or prepare irreversible issuance, custody, liability, external action, reconciliation, payout, and payment behavior.

lanes.trigger: A terminally failed cycle authorizes a successor or receives a delayed return.
lanes.disposition: Require the exact failed cycle and failure-receipt digest, a fresh cycle identifier and nonce, a distinct immutable return escrow, one active cycle, and zero successor balance contribution from every delayed predecessor return.

scope: raw provider snapshots and independent decoders when used as gate evidence
returned-USDG attribution proof and proceeds-key verification
risk, proof, finality, and release decisions for R4 actions
lanes.reason: These surfaces determine whether an R4 action is authentic, reproducible, correctly bound, and releasable.
These surfaces remain medium risk only while they cannot move assets, prepare a signable action, change authority, freeze interfaces, or attest release readiness.
R1 applies only when prose cannot change executable behavior, authority, evidence meaning, interface truth, or release status.

pendingEscalations.trigger: Programmable adds Robinhood chain 4663 or changes its Launchpad, graph, admission, hook, wallet-handoff, fee, or evidence profile.
pendingEscalations.requiredLane: R4 for production interfaces or implementation; R3 for read-only binding evidence
pendingEscalations.disposition: Re-run official discovery, capability, runtime, preflight, admission, fee, source, indexing, and architecture-consistency evidence before interface freeze.

pendingEscalations.trigger: Relay or another provider becomes the exact outbound or return conversion binding.
pendingEscalations.requiredLane: R4 for POST quote requests, executable payload construction, signatures, broadcasts, spending, receipt consumption, and live roundtrip actions; R3 for public capability reads, independently reviewed decoders, finalized evidence, returned-USDG attribution, and gate decisions
pendingEscalations.disposition: Treat POST /quote/v2 as ask-first external API mutation; bind exact request and response fields, contracts or programs, assets, wallets, refund and recovery paths, fees, feature switches, minimum receives, deadlines, finality, unique receipt semantics, and raw bytes; reject generic provider fallback.

pendingEscalations.trigger: Collector authentication, pack, generate, open, buyback, prize-wallet, refund, or transaction schema changes or is selected for release.
pendingEscalations.disposition: Resolve the documented-authentication conflict; authorize generate, open, buyback, key access, signature, principal, gas, and submitTransaction broadcast separately; independently decode every payload and prove custody and finality.

pendingEscalations.trigger: A launch, deployment, market admission, pool initialization, source-verification publication, canary swap, process release, payout funding, or holder-payment action is prepared.
pendingEscalations.disposition: Require official chain support, complete local and fork proof, positive gas and size headroom, exact byte decoding, separate action authorization, exact destinations and caps, and independent finalized evidence. No readiness artifact grants action authority.

pendingEscalations.trigger: Returned USDG, a closed cycle, or a proceeds-attribution key is used to prepare a distribution or payout.
pendingEscalations.requiredLane: R4 for production reconciliation and payout preparation; R3 for independent evidence and gate decisions
pendingEscalations.disposition: Require an activity-isolated finalized PegCycleVault USDG balance window, matching decoded return receipt and logs, closed journal, exact positive delta, domain-separated single-use proceeds key, zero Operations balance basis, and concurrent replay rejection.

pendingEscalations.trigger: A publication location becomes part of payout preflight.
pendingEscalations.disposition: Bind source precedence, finality, freshness, byte identity, independence, and unavailable or inconsistent behavior.

pendingEscalations.trigger: A certified module is introduced or any project module is mapped to a certified parameter envelope.
pendingEscalations.requiredLane: The highest class touched by any unsupported delta
pendingEscalations.disposition: Record and review every delta before task planning or build execution.
